cards.name: vehicle-log-monthly-filter
cards.description: Use date range or month extraction for monthly vehicle log queries instead of listing individual days.
cards.claim: When filtering vehicle_log by month, use a date range (e.g., date >= '2025-06-01' AND date < '2025-07-01') or strftime/EXTRACT functions, not a list of individual day conditions.

cards.name: attendance-absence-interpretation
cards.description: The 'A' column in staff attendance sheets represents the total count of absent days for the month.
cards.claim: The column 'A' contains the pre-calculated total number of absent days for the period. Do not sum the daily columns (1-31) to find absences; use the 'A' column directly for totals and rankings.
